packages.name: Coastal Adventure
packages.summary: Islands, the golden beaches of Ponta do Ouro and the calm lagoon of Bilene — quad biking, horse riding and a sunset cruise along the way.
packages.intro:
Discover the beauty of southern Mozambique through a combination of coastal adventures, island experiences and relaxing beach destinations.

Explore the islands of Inhaca and Portuguese Island, enjoy the beaches of Ponta do Ouro and experience the peaceful lagoon of Bilene.
